recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Sovereign country. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
currency: Cooperation Financiere en Afrique Centrale francs (XAF)
rulers: President Faustin-Archange TOUADÉRA (since 30 March 2016); Prime Minister Félix MOLOUA (since 7 February 2022)
economy: enormous natural resources; extreme poverty; weak public institutions and infrastructure; political and gender-based violence have led to displacement of roughly 25% of population; Bangui-Douala corridor blockade reduced activity and tax collection; strong agricultural performance offset COVID-19 downturn GDP (PPP): $5.926 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Central African Armed Forces (Forces Armees Centrafricaines, FACA): Army (includes an air squadron, Escadrille Centrafricaine) Ministry of Interior: National Gendarmerie (Gendarmerie Nationale), National Police (2025) Expenditure: 2.5% of GDP (2024 est.)
